name: AI Recipe: PR Review
description: Claude reviews every open pull request in one GitHub repo against a fixed set of gates (red or pending checks, conflicts, secrets, infra files, destructive migrations, unrelated changes, human markers) and writes a verdict per PR. Report mode is read-only; comment mode posts one comment per PR; merge mode squash-merges the ones that pass and holds the rest.

parameters.label: ai-automation-recipes clone
parameters.help: Absolute path to your local clone of ai-automation-tools/ai-automation-recipes.

parameters.label: Output folder
parameters.help: Root folder for all recipe output. Each recipe writes into its own collection under it.

parameters.label: GitHub repository
parameters.help: owner/name of the repository to review. The GitHub CLI (gh) must be installed and logged in to an account that can read it, and write to it for comment or merge mode.

parameters.label: Mode
parameters.help: report only writes the review. comment also posts one comment per PR. merge also squash-merges every PR that passes every gate and leaves a hold comment on the rest.

parameters.label: Claude model
parameters.help: Claude model alias for the run.

author: ai-automation-tools
